properties.name: compare_designs and compose_and_analyse take the other design by graph_id (the cross-design layer's first step)
properties.rationale: Anthony, 2026-10-10/11: the cross-design primitive layer (dec:idea-cross-design-operations-are-a-primitive-layer-served-by-the-registry-by-graph-id, option a) and "do the next build". The first step the requirement names: the two operations whose core already takes a GraphExport, served by graph_id over the designs one process holds, bounded by the readable set the host hands over (dec:a-cross-design-read-is-bounded-by-the-readable-set-the-host-hands-over-not-by-the-root-alone, settled the same night). Failing first: 5 of 5 wire tests failed on the unchanged binary; 6 of 6 pass with the change; full workspace 3,226 passed. Owed next: the flo2 gateway's half (readable_graph_ids on reads, compare_designs off the refused list with its paths refused as arguments, membership on other_graph_id) and the measurement of the second design's open cost on flo2.io before the family is widened. properties.subject: system
properties.summary: A Weak registry handle on ReflowService (set in open_design, None in wrap_at, cloned in share()), RegistryHandle::other_design_export(graph_id) on service_for + the store's read guard, dropped before return; _meta["reflow2/readable_graph_ids"] read per call like writes_for; one resolver ReflowService::other_design refusing in order — no registry, own id, caller rule not a trusted gateway or bearer, no set on the call, id not in the set (naming the id, never what it holds). compare_designs: base_path optional, other_graph_id added, a path refused on a registry server (the hole the survey found, measured live before the change). compose_and_analyse: design optional, other_graph_id added, exactly one; namespace defaults to the graph_id. Toolsnaps for the two tools re-blessed (optional fields, nullable types); find_tools rank baseline pair removed as its test instructs; the task-local allowed in no_per_design_process_globals with its reason; AGENTS.md gains "Cross-design reads by graph_id, and what a registry server refuses"; changelog fragment (Added + Fixed).
